title: Can Large Language Models Replace Human Subjects? A Large-Scale Replication of Scenario-Based Experiments in Psychology and Management

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the replication success rates, statistical significance, and effect size deviations of scenario-based psychological experiments involving race or ethnicity variables against studies without such variables.

Comparing the replication success rates, statistical significance, and effect size deviations of scenario-based psychological experiments involving gender variables against studies without such variables.

Evaluating the replication rates of scenario-based experiments involving ethical considerations and socially sensitive topics to measure the models' tendency to output socially desirable or alignment-filtered responses rather than true human behavioral patterns.
